name: standmeet-fsmcp-mcp
description: fsmcp block as a dsh plugin: the third-party @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem (a Node stdio-MCP server) bridged onto dsh through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. This subject package is a thin shell — it declares the server as a dependency (so dsh installs it into the profile) and carries the mcp-client patch; index.js is a stub only so dsh's package-entry resolution succeeds.
